verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented sandbox or staging environment isolated from production. What it does document is testing transformation code against sample events before deploying, and an Event Playground that sends sample events into RudderStack. Both are dry-run or test-harness features for individual pieces, not an isolated sandbox environment, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
